notes: No computing-unit or school-level AI policy found for Davis. Campus layer (not collected here): the Code of Academic Conduct (ossja.ucdavis.edu) lists unauthorized AI-generated content as misconduct unless the instructor authorizes it in writing (reported in search snippets; first collection did not fetch it; worth retrying), IET student guide (iet.ucdavis.edu/aggie-ai/student-guide-gen-ai) and IET AI guidance (iet.ucdavis.edu/aggie-ai/ai-guidance), and CEE guidance. UC Davis does not require instructors to have an AI policy. The School of Medicine has its own acceptable-use policy (not computing). Main limitation: cs.ucdavis.edu and engineering.ucdavis.edu return 403, so a policy on those sites cannot be ruled out; a manual browser check of their student-handbook and instructor-resource pages is advised.
